job.title: Senior Engineering Manager
job.description: Leads and develops a software engineering team through coaching, feedback, hiring, and career growth. Partners with product and engineering leadership on priorities, execution, architecture, and technical strategy. Reviews system designs, evaluates tradeoffs, supports code reviews, and drives improvements in scalability, reliability, performance, testing, and engineering processes.
responsibilities: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers with a strong focus on people development, team health, and career growth
Support engineers through regular coaching, feedback, goal setting, and career development conversations
Create clarity for the team around priorities, expectations, ownership, and successful outcomes
Partner closely with product and engineering leadership to define priorities, drive execution, and deliver successful outcomes
Support projects from early planning and architecture through implementation, rollout, and long-term maintenance
Stay close to the technical work by understanding system design, reviewing technical plans, participating in architecture discussions, and helping evaluate tradeoffs
Assist with code reviews and technical feedback where helpful
Help unblock engineers by providing context, asking the right questions, connecting people, and clarifying priorities
Contribute to the conceptualization and technical design of new ideas and product enhancements
Help drive architectural improvements that prioritize scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance
Reinforce strong engineering standards, development practices, testing habits, and ownership across the team
